Two commits broke the tests, one bug each. I fixed both with one-line changes in the source and left the tests alone.

1. **`958d3ae` Money: thousands separators in formatMoney.** The cents part was padded with `padEnd` instead of `padStart`, so 1 cent showed as `$0.10` instead of `$0.01` (also 9, 101 and -1 cents, and the `PIN-03` row in the rendered invoice).
   Fix in `src/money.js:16`: changed `padEnd` back to `padStart`. The thousands separators still work.

2. **`4188e9a` Invoice: per-line discount groundwork.** It changed the tax base to `const taxable = subtotal;`, which charges tax before the order code is taken off. The v2.0.0 code taxed `subtotal - discount`. This broke the two CA-ON SPRING10 tests and the matching total row in the rendered invoice.
   Fix in `src/invoice.js:22`: changed it to `const taxable = subtotal - discount;`. Line discounts are already removed from the subtotal, so they stay as they were.

Everything else those commits added is kept: line discounts and their validation, the `lineDiscounts` and `taxable` fields, the empty-invoice check, and the JSDoc.

`npm test`: 517 passed, 517 total, exit code 0. Changes are not committed.
